title: Heart of Christmas Celebration
seo_title: Heart of Christmas Celebration at Big Cedar Lodge
description: Heart of Christmas Celebration is a holiday event at Big Cedar Lodge featuring a heartwarming holiday story, live performances, and festive characters. Family and friends are invited to gather for what the lodge describes as its biggest holiday celebration to date. It takes place Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 5:30 PM at 190 Top of the Rock Rd in Ridgedale, MO.
address: 190 Top of the Rock rd, Ridgedale, MO, 65739
